title: Build a shelter before the storm (relaxed rule)
description: Same setup as shelter_01 but the validity rule is relaxed: you may use natural terrain (trees, stone outcrops) as part of your shelter boundary, provided you still contribute at least 12 placed blocks. Storm still arrives at turn 30.
goal: Build a shelter (≥ 3×3 floor, closed boundary with at least 12 placed blocks; natural terrain allowed for the rest) and be inside by turn 30.
notes: The only change from shelter_01 is the boundary-placedness rule. Natural trees, stone, dirt, or grass blocks may form part of the boundary; you must still contribute ≥ 12 placed blocks.
Budget-wise this lets you dig into a tree cluster, seal the open sides with placed wood, and call it a shelter — a more natural strategy under the 30-turn deadline.
